amendment: Before a valid baseline was produced, v1.0.0 was corrected after archive inspection showed a 4x6 well layout (A01-D06), not A01-A24, and one-based annotation coordinates. No algorithm metric informed this correction.

population.exclusion_policy: Exclude only missing, unreadable, dimension-mismatched, or annotation-missing samples; record every exclusion as a failure.

split.method: Fixed-seed random selection without site-level leakage
split.test_access_policy: The baseline may be measured on test. Improved-pipeline parameters are selected only from development results, then the fixed improved configuration is evaluated once on test.

ground_truth.semantic_target: Pixelwise union of the binary CELLMASK and NUCLMASK TIFF files
ground_truth.semantic_rationale: The source image contains colored cell body and blue nucleus. CELLMASK and NUCLMASK are disjoint components, so their union represents visible whole-cell foreground.
ground_truth.count_target: Number of annotation CSV rows for ImageName; 40 for every supplied image
ground_truth.detection_points: LocationX is image column and LocationY is image row; both are one-based and are converted to zero-based array indices by subtracting one
ground_truth.instance_limitation: Cell masks are binary semantic masks, not instance IDs. Object matching therefore uses annotated center points and does not claim instance-mask IoU.

configuration.minimum_object_size: max(8, image_pixels * 0.00004), equal to 36 pixels at 950x950
configuration.watershed: negative Euclidean distance within binary foreground

development_only_search.selection_metric: mean semantic Dice + 0.25 * (1 - clipped mean absolute percentage count error)

metrics.aggregation: Macro mean across images; count RMSE is computed across per-image count errors.
